visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a solid blue screen with centered white text and a single white dot that rhythmically scales. (2) A man wearing glasses, a grey t-shirt, a white towel around his neck, and a beige cap sits motionless on a brown leather sofa in a bright indoor room with large windows behind him. (3) The camera cuts to a side view of a man (same person) wearing a blue shirt and a black cap backwards, holding a professional camera with a large lens; he looks frustrated and gestures with his hands while talking. (4) Shots alternate between the man on the sofa looking bored and the man with the camera holding up a small white card labeled 'Go Goal'. (5) A fast-paced montage begins: a hand pours water into a blender bottle containing chocolate powder; the man on the sofa drinks from a glass of chocolate-colored liquid; he then holds up multiple white packets of protein powder and later points at a can and several bags of chips on a light wood table. (6) The man eats a chip and gestures emphatically towards the camera, sitting on the floor next to the table crowded with Body Goals products. (7) He holds up a large white box with 'Body Goals' branding. (8) A woman with long black hair, wearing a navy track jacket with white stripes and a black mask, is seen from the side in an office, talking on a smartphone. (9) The man in the grey shirt is seen on the floor doing rapid push-ups as a white dot pulses over his body.
